name: Tabs
summary: Switch between sibling views inside the same destination. Three chrome variants — pill (sunken track + raised thumb, Apple-flavor), underline (linear sub-nav, Linear-flavor), enclosed (bordered panel, admin-flavor). Distinct from Segmented (single-choice control inside a form row) and from Navbar tabs (top-level nav). One thumb visible at a time. Tab content lives in `<TabsPanel>` siblings with matching `value`.

value.description: Controlled active panel id. Must match a TabsTrigger value.

onValueChange.description: Fires with the new value when the active tab changes.

variant.description: pill: sunken track + raised lime-tinted thumb (default; Apple Sport-flavor). underline: linear with a moving lime underline — the operator sub-nav default; pairs with `density='dense'`. enclosed: bordered panel with the active tab notched into the top edge — admin and settings pages.

density.description: compact: 28 px height, type.label.sm. dense: 32 px height, type.label.md. regular: 36 px height, type.label.md. Touch-target floor is 44 px on mobile — the consumer is responsible for choosing regular on mobile.

orientation.description: vertical mounts the TabsList as a left-rail column. roving tabindex follows orientation.

fitted.description: TabsList stretches to 100% width and each TabsTrigger flex-1s. Pair with horizontal.

overflow.description: When triggers overflow the track: scroll exposes a horizontal scroll affordance (mobile default); menu collapses overflowing triggers into a 'More' DropdownMenu (desktop default).

asChild.description: Forward to the consumer's rendering primitive (Radix-style slot).

keyboard: Tab - enter the tablist, focus the active TabsTrigger
ArrowLeft / ArrowRight - move focus between triggers (horizontal)
ArrowUp / ArrowDown - move focus between triggers (vertical)
Enter / Space - activate focused trigger (manual mode)
rules: Tablist uses roving tabindex — only the active trigger is tabbable; the rest take focus via arrow keys.
Each TabsTrigger announces aria-selected=true|false and links to its TabsPanel via aria-controls.
Each TabsPanel announces aria-labelledby pointing at its trigger.

Automatic activation (focus = activate) is the default on horizontal; manual activation (focus moves, Space/Enter activates) is the default on vertical to avoid surprising state changes when the user is scanning options.

Honor prefers-reduced-motion: pill-variant thumb still slides under the active tab but skips the 220 ms scale-from-0.96 entry on first mount; underline-variant translateX still animates (motion that follows the user's intent stays per principle 4 of micro-interactions.md).

The pill thumb position is rendered via inline style.left + style.width tracked from each trigger's bounding rect (per AGENTS.md hard rule 12 — never Tailwind arbitrary translate classes for position math).

do: Use Tabs to switch between sibling views of the same destination. Page changes belong in a Navbar; row-level filters belong in Segmented.
Lead each trigger with a short noun: 'Overview', 'Activity', 'Settings'. Avoid verbs in triggers — they sound like buttons.
Pair the underline variant with operator sub-navigation under a page header. The single moving lime underline is the brand stroke — never paint a static lime underline on inactive triggers.
When triggers overflow on desktop, collapse to a 'More' DropdownMenu rather than scroll-clip the affordance.
Keep the panel content tall enough that no vertical layout shift occurs when switching tabs (allocate min-height or use a Suspense boundary).
dont: Don't stack more than 7 triggers — beyond that, switch to a sidebar list or a select.
Don't put a destructive action inside a TabsTrigger label. Destructive belongs in the panel, behind a guard.
Don't render two simultaneous thumb chromes (e.g. underline + raised pill). One indicator per Tabs instance.
Don't use Tabs to gate a multi-step flow — that's Stepper.

Don't paint the active trigger in lime fill (#00FA8A is the action accent; an active tab is selection, not action). Use color.action.selected.bg for the pill thumb; color.border.accent for the underline; color.text.accent for the active trigger label.

changelog.note: Initial Tabs contract formalizes the audit-dashboard implementation. Three variants (pill / underline / enclosed). Roving tabindex. Inline-style thumb position math per AGENTS.md hard rule 12. Overflow-to-DropdownMenu pattern for desktop densities.
